jobs.description:
What you'll do
You will join the Technology Department's Machine Protection and Electrical Integrity (MPE) Group, which develops and maintains systems that protect accelerator equipment, including magnets and particle-beam-related installations.

Working in a collaborative team of software engineers, you will design, develop and maintain reliable software that supports the safe and efficient operation of the Large Hadron Collider and its injector complex. You will have the opportunity to solve challenging engineering problems, collaborate with experts across different disciplines and contribute to systems that are essential to CERN's scientific mission.

Your responsibilities
-Design, implement, test and maintain software components that interface with equipment protection and interlock systems.
-Monitor deployed applications, investigate technical issues and improve reliability, availability and maintainability.
-Work with engineers, technical specialists and accelerator operations teams during commissioning, testing and operation.
-Understand user requirements, contribute to technical decisions and help deliver sustainable software solutions.
-Collaborate with colleagues to strengthen development workflows, automated testing, continuous integration and software quality, including exploring AI-assisted development tools where appropriate.
-Provide technical guidance and mentoring to colleagues and students.

Your profile
-Solid software engineering experience, including proficiency in Java and/or C++.
-Experience in designing, developing, testing and maintaining software throughout its lifecycle.
-Proficiency with software development practices such as version control, automated testing, continuous integration and delivery.
-Strong technical acumen in translating complex requirements into robust, efficient, and maintainable solutions.
-Master's Degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Computing, Physics or Engineering or a related field.

Your skills
-Development of application software: core software design principles and application development.
-Knowledge and application of software life-cycle tools and procedures: including Agile methodologies (Kanban, Scrum), Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery, Quality Assurance and DevOps.
-Capturing and analysis of requirements for ICT systems: working with end users to understand their needs and providing corresponding technical solutions.
-Installation, operation and maintenance (preventive and corrective) of computing systems: including monitoring, diagnosing and support of live, operational systems.
-Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
-Expresses opinions, ideas and suggestions with conviction and in a logical/structured manner; keeps to the point.
-Shares knowledge and expertise freely and willingly with others; coaches others to ensure knowledge transfer.
-Has a structured and organised approach towards work; is able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.
-Is able to put self in the shoes of others in order to understand their needs and interests.
-Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Ideal start date: 01/04/2027
Contract duration (in months): 60
Grade range: 6
Benchmark job: 200020 - Computing Engineer
Job flexibility: Hybrid
Team supervision

Do you enjoy finding the tiny details that make a big difference? As a component tester, you will help make digital solutions stable, reliable and ready to meet real user needs. Your work will connect testing, technology and teamwork—plus a healthy amount of curiosity.
You will work with component-level testing throughout the development process. That means checking that individual parts behave as expected, spotting issues early and helping the team turn findings into better solutions.
What you will do
You will plan, perform and improve tests for digital components. The role includes both hands-on testing and close collaboration with people working across development and product-related areas.
Create and maintain component test cases based on requirements and expected behaviour
Execute manual and automated tests
Investigate, reproduce and document defects clearly
Work with developers to identify root causes and verify fixes
Contribute to test automation and continuous improvement of testing methods
Share test results and help make quality visible across the team

What you bring
We are looking for someone who is structured, curious and comfortable asking questions when something does not quite add up. You enjoy working with technical details while keeping the bigger user experience in mind.
At least 2 years of experience in software testing or a similar quality-focused role
Experience with component testing, test case design and defect reporting
Familiarity with test automation and scripting
Understanding of software development and testing life cycles
Ability to analyse problems, reproduce issues and communicate findings clearly
Good command of English, both written and spoken

Experience with the following is considered a merit:
Working with continuous integration and continuous delivery environments
Using version control systems such as Git
Testing APIs or integrations
Working in cross-functional teams
Experience with tools for test management or defect tracking

Why join us?
You will join a private company in HR and recruitment technology, focused on developing scalable, digital solutions. The organisation combines people, data and digital technology in an innovative and collaborative environment, with a focus on improving experiences for candidates, recruiters and HR teams.
The company offers a flexible and open culture that values diversity, respect and psychological safety. You will have opportunities to learn, share knowledge, take initiative and develop professionally while contributing to work that brings together technology and human-centred thinking.
Flexible work arrangements, including opportunities for remote or hybrid work
Comprehensive health insurance and pension plans
Generous leave and holiday policies, often including extra leave for important life events
Opportunities for professional development and career growth
A supportive and inclusive work environment that values work–life balance, respect and wellbeing

How to apply
Please apply through the application form and submit your CV and a cover letter. We review applications on a rolling basis.

🚀 We’re Hiring: Senior Embedded Software Application Engineer – Engine Control Systems | MATLAB/Simulink
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Senior Embedded Software Application Engineer for a consulting opportunity in the automotive and powertrain technology sector.
Are you passionate about embedded software, control systems, and model-based development? Do you have experience designing and implementing control strategies for complex engine systems? This opportunity allows you to contribute to the development of future engine technologies, from advanced engineering concepts to production-ready ECU software.
🔧 About the Role
You will work with an experienced engineering team responsible for designing, implementing, and verifying control functionality for combustion engines.
Your main focus will be developing new control strategies for future engine concepts and implementing robust software solutions in Electronic Control Units (ECUs) for production. You will collaborate closely with hardware engineers and specialists in calibration and optimisation across an international engineering environment.
The role covers the complete development lifecycle, including advanced engineering, industrialisation, maintenance, and quality improvements.
🎯 Key Responsibilities
Design and implement control strategies for embedded engine control systems.
Develop software for future engine concepts and production-ready ECU applications.
Model and implement control functionality using MATLAB, Simulink, and TargetLink.
Verify and validate embedded software functionality.
Collaborate with hardware design, calibration, and optimisation teams.
Contribute to technical problem-solving across complex engine systems.
Support industrialisation, maintenance activities, and software quality improvements.
Work collaboratively with engineering teams across different locations to deliver reliable solutions.

✅ Required Skills & Experience
Master's degree in Mechatronics or a related technical field.
Strong understanding of control theory, control-system modelling, and embedded software.
Experience designing and implementing control strategies in embedded control systems.
Practical knowledge of MATLAB and Simulink.
Experience or familiarity with TargetLink and model-based software development.
Understanding of ECU software implementation and verification.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good spoken and written English.
Ability to work effectively in small, agile teams within an international engineering environment.

⭐ Nice to Have
Experience developing embedded software for combustion engines or powertrain systems.
Experience with TargetLink-based code generation and model-based development workflows.
Knowledge of engine calibration, optimisation, and hardware integration.
Experience working across advanced engineering, production development, and maintenance phases.
Familiarity with agile development practices in automotive engineering.

👤 Who Should Apply?
We are looking for a technically curious and collaborative engineer who can take ownership of complex engineering challenges and drive solutions forward. You should enjoy working with control systems, translating technical concepts into working embedded software, and collaborating across hardware and software disciplines.
📩 Interested in This Opportunity?
Please submit your updated CV highlighting your experience in embedded software development, engine control strategies, MATLAB/Simulink, TargetLink, and ECU implementation.

Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Role Summary
An experienced Scrum Master/Agile Coach is needed for a consulting assignment within a large organisation undergoing a transformation to improve and coordinate its agile product development. The assignment focuses on supporting the consolidation of four previously separate products and backlogs into one unified product with a clearly prioritised common backlog.
You will coach and support 3–4 development teams throughout this transition, helping establish shared ways of working, stronger cross-team collaboration, and effective delivery processes. The role requires a confident agile leader who can drive change pragmatically, create engagement, and enable teams and stakeholders to work toward common product goals.
Key Responsibilities
Coach and facilitate 3–4 agile development teams in their day-to-day delivery and continuous improvement work.
Support the transition from separate products and backlogs to a unified product and prioritised common backlog.
Develop, implement, and continuously improve shared agile processes and ways of working across teams.
Facilitate Scrum ceremonies and ensure they provide clear value for teams and stakeholders.
Identify, visualise, and help manage dependencies between teams, product areas, and deliveries.
Strengthen collaboration and alignment among development teams working toward the same product objectives.
Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, and business stakeholders to monitor delivery flow and prioritisation.
Drive data-informed improvement initiatives focused on capacity, delivery predictability, and operational efficiency.
Use flow-based metrics, including Throughput, Work in Progress (WIP), Lead Time, and Cycle Time, to support improvement efforts.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Deep practical knowledge of Scrum, Kanban, and agile ways of working.
Hands-on experience using Jira for backlog management, sprint planning, and capacity planning.
Experience with agile transformation and organisational change management.
Knowledge of scaled agile frameworks such as SAFe, LeSS, or Nexus is advantageous.
Experience facilitating work across multiple teams delivering toward a shared product and common backlog.
Ability to use delivery-flow data and relevant metrics to identify bottlenecks and drive measurable improvements.

Qualifications & Experience
The ideal consultant has at least 8 years of experience as a Scrum Master in large organisations. You have documented experience coaching and facilitating 3–4 agile teams in parallel, coordinating teams working toward a shared product or backlog, and leading agile transformation initiatives. Experience consolidating multiple backlogs into one common backlog is desirable. You are structured, pragmatic, and solution-oriented, with the ability to create engagement and effective collaboration across teams and stakeholders.
Professional fluency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken, is required.

At Qred, we’re building the world's best bank for small businesses. Since launching 11 years ago, we’ve grown from startup to profitable fintech scale-up, now generating over 1 billion SEK in annual revenue and supporting 50,000+ entrepreneurs across Northern Europe. We combine smart technology, real data, and human judgment to make financing simple, fast, and fair. With bold growth plans and strong momentum across multiple markets, we’re now looking for a Customer Representative for the next phase of growth.
About the Role
As a Customer Representative, you will drive end-to-end communication with small businesses while maintaining operational accuracy across our core financial channels. You take direct ownership of real-time inquiries, bridging customer needs with our internal financial systems to power steady scale.
Key responsibilities
Resolve customer inquiries across chat, email, and phone with technical precision and speed.

Process daily operational requests in accordance with regulatory standards and risk policies.

Align with cross-functional teams to resolve edge cases and optimize internal workflows.

Identify operational bottlenecks and contribute practical ideas to refine service procedures.

Document customer records and system updates accurately within our internal platforms.

What we’re looking for
We are looking for an action-oriented team player with a structured mindset and strong problem-solving skills. You take full ownership of daily tasks, adapt quickly to shifting priorities, and remain motivated to build efficient, scalable interactions.
Qualifications
Practical experience in customer-facing roles, retail, or operations, or an eagerness to launch your career in Fintech.

Fluent in English and at least one Scandinavian language (Swedish, Norwegian, or Danish)

Strong digital proficiency with the ability to navigate internal financial systems and administrative software effectively.

Why Qred?
This is the place to be if you’re looking for a place to grow. Qred is growing fast, and our Qredsters along with it. With a non-bureaucratic organization and delegated responsibilities, we make sure there’s a short path from idea to action. In addition to our great culture, you get to work with the latest cutting-edge techniques, full ownership, and last but not least a bunch of great competent colleagues to learn from!
One Last Thing
This is a full-time, permanent position based in our headquarters in Stockholm. We believe our culture thrives when we work together, which is why we have an office-first approach. To balance this with some flexibility, we have the option of working remotely one day per week.
We review applications on a rolling basis and while the start date is flexible, the right candidate can join us immediately.
Qred celebrates diversity and does not discriminate based on ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.

jobs.description:
Objektvision is rebuilding its platform from scratch and is looking for a Senior Product Designer to help shape it. If you'd rather ship real UI in Claude Code than polish screens in Figma, this could be your next step.
The role
You'll be part of the team building our new customer platform: the tool property owners, managers and brokers log into to list, manage and rent out their space. That covers the obvious parts, like making it effortless to publish a listing, and the less obvious ones: access levels, billing and invoicing, and the view our customer service team works in every day. You need to understand the system behind the screens, not just the screens. 
The Product Manager prototypes ideas and tests them with customers. Once we decide to go for something, you take over: you design the interaction and UI and build the frontend yourself in Claude Code, so it's close to ready when the Full-stack Engineer picks it up. You'll design AI-powered features like listing quality scoring and matching together with our Data & AI Lead, and help build one shared design system for all markets. 
You work daily with a Product Manager and a Full-stack Engineer, and you'll have another Product Designer in the company to exchange ideas and feedback with. 
About you

5+ years in product design, with a portfolio of shipped products. A background in development before moving into design is a big plus

Hands-on with Claude Code (or similar) for prototyping and real frontend work

Comfortable in HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React (or similar)

Pragmatic and quick to move; you know when something is good enough to ship, and you enjoy finding the best solution together with the team

Fluent in English; working/conversational Swedish required (team language is English, but daily life at the office is in Swedish)

Nice to have: experience designing AI features (chat, agents, recommendations), owning a design system, or a marketplace/proptech background 

About Objektvision
Objektvision is Sweden's leading marketplace for commercial real estate, part of Finland's Alma Media. They're rebuilding their entire platform from the ground up, going AI-first and shared across markets. Being a small company means they can actually change how they work, not just talk about it. You'll be based centrally in Stockholm, in the office Tuesday to Thursday, with flexibility to work from home the rest of the week. The culture is close-knit and generous - shared lunches, regular offsites, and a wellness allowance, with occasional trips to the team in Finland. 
Application
We review applications continuously, so please apply as soon as possible. Objektvision is collaborating with Ants for this recruitment. Questions about the role? Reach out to Julia Lagerblad at Ants: julia.lagerblad@ants.se

For this position we are looking for an individual who has a background within traceability & data transactions and is passionate to set the foundation and help drive our digitalization Journey within the Aftermarket, Service & Quality organization, part of the Business Unit Europe.
Typical areas of responsibility are to support both internal and external customers in problems related to product individual data from factories & suppliers.
You will be troubleshooting data issues that might occur related to individual product serial numbers, wrong master data and other things that may interfere with the data submission.
Help to track data quality issues and even coordinate with factories or suppliers the solution.
In this role one would also be working together with the Global operations team and the Global Information Systems organization.
You would be supporting the team responsible for implementing projects like Digital Product Passport and Husqvarna Serial Number roll out.

Your future challenge
This new role is positioned in the Digital Infrastructure team, belonging to Digital Data Solutions, where the role will be working together with our traceability analyst and reporting to the Global Traceability manager.
This person works in close cooperation with the Digital Product, Operational Excellence, Aftermarket & Services team, Data Management team, Operations team as well as with suppliers.

Tasks

• Collaborate with the Global Traceability Manager to develop and maintain data collection and reporting systems.
• Drive analytics of individual product data deliveries from suppliers, change management/project leading skill (to drive implementation and changes of integrations against suppliers as well educating internal users).
• Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity by conducting regular audits and reconciliations.
• Provide administrative support, including managing documentation, scheduling meetings, and coordinating communication.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to address data-related challenges and optimize traceability processes.
• Do/support error analysis of data and drive needed actions for stable data deliveries.
• Follow up / establish KPI on performance of deliveries.
• Analyze data related to product individual identification and identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement.

Required skills
• University Computer Engineering degree, Supply Chain Management or equivalent experience.
• Proven experience in data analysis, preferably in manufacturing companies.
• Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI) and Microsoft Excel.
• Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.
• Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
• Knowledge of APIs (REST, JSON) and system integrations is a plus.
• Knowledge of traceability systems and manufacturing execution systems best practices is a plus.
• You are fluent in English (preferably also additional languages – Swedish is a plus).
• Be able to work in a multi-cultural context both internally and externally and since all is carried out in an international context.

The opportunity
Do you want to work in a future-focused industry where technology meets sustainability? Do you thrive in an environment where you can grow and make a real difference?
At Hitachi Energy, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Design Engineer to join our engineering team within Grid Automation Sweden. In this role, you will work with advanced technology and substation automation, contributing to a sustainable and secure energy future. You will be part of an inclusive and innovative workplace where collaboration, learning, and development are part of everyday work, and where flexible ways of working support your work–life balance.
"For me, it’s important that everyone in the team feels they contribute, grow, and continuously develop. I believe in giving people trust and the space to excel, take ownership, and step up to new challenges. If you’re looking for a role where you can grow and make a real impact, I’d love to hear from you." — Malin Friman, Project Engineering Team Leader at Grid Automation
How you’ll make an impact
Design relay and control systems for substations
Collaborate with customers and project teams
Lead electrical design activities in projects
Provide technical expertise and innovative solutions
Collaborate with international engineering teams in India and the Czech Republic
Ensure quality and efficiency in project delivery
Contribute to a culture of safety, quality, and innovation
Share knowledge and support team development

Your background
Minimum 5 years of experience in electrical design within transmission and distribution projects
Experience using EPC ElMaster for design and drafting. Experience with E3 is also considered relevant.
Proficiency in Swedish and English
Proactive and solution-oriented mindset with ability to identify opportunities, collaborate, and take the lead when needed
A university degree or vocational (YH) education in electrical or other relevant technical field is considered an advantage

What we offer
Flexible working arrangements
Collective agreement
Health and wellness allowance
Career growth within a global organization
Mentorship during onboarding
Learning and development opportunities
Diverse workplace with 70+ nationalities represented in Swede
Supplementary compensation for parental leave
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks

The key responsibility of the Quality Control technician is for  receiving  and analyzing test material, incoming parts, product intermediates and finalized products for Research & Development, Testing & Validation, and Production using a range of instruments as well as participating in problem solving and technical troubleshooting exercises on the execution side.   
Key Responsibilities 
Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to)  
Execute work instructions and participate in laboratory functions/tasks/work.   
Follow 5S and safety protocols within the production and laboratory work environment.  
Conduct analysis on a wide range of instruments and report data/results for a diverse set of samples in the expected template and/or Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS); and maintain control charts.  
Able to understand and execute testing and validation plans for incoming parts, product intermediates, finalized products, and other material accordingly. 
Identify problems with test material, analysis methods, and instrumentation.   
Be able to troubleshoot basic to advance problems; utilizing the help of suppliers or experts for more major issues.   
Understand the fundamental principles of method development and/or method validation and able to participate in the execution.   
Able to write support documentation for standard operations.  
Maintaining instruments and measurement areas to a high standard, involving responsibility to ensure that the laboratory or production room(s)/area(s) comply with safety related guidelines, 5S guidelines, maintaining consumable inventory and instrument readiness.  
Able to train and qualifying personnel according to a skill and competence level.  
Strict adherence to Quality Assurance and Quality Control Principles.   
Participate in improvement plans and investigations for various topics.   

Accountability/Authorization 
Budget responsibility: No  
Direct reports: No  
Work Environment responsibility: No 

All employees are accountable for complying with safety regulations and actively supporting a safe workplace. 

Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role. 
Qualifications and experience  
Bachelor´s degree or master’s degree in a technical field is preferred.  
2 years experience in quality control from relevant industry is preferred.  
Specific knowledge in any relevant instrumentation, measurement system, or scientific field used by the company. (preferred)  
Familiar with quality management systems, e.g. ISO 9001, IATF16949, Total Quality Management (TQM). 
Familiar with Statistical Process Control (SPC), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Control Plan (CP), Lean, Six Sigma, Quality troubleshooting tools and problem-solving methodology. (Preferred)  
Curious, technically educated and preferably with a strong business background.  
Experience in Cell Manufacturing, or Test and Validation is an advantage.  

 Specific skills & Knowledge 
Knowledge of Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS) or other sample tracking software is a plus.  
Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams.  
High work ethic, critical thinking, and strong problem-solving skills are a must.  
This role requires the ability to stand for extended periods and perform manual labor in physically demanding environments. This can include 100% working hours allocation into clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. The role also requires working shifts and working in multiple process areas, according to business needs. This role requires working full-time on the shop floor, supporting operation.
